contract: Return one complete Sounio source file only; start with code, not Markdown.
Use Sounio syntax: `var` for mutable bindings, `&!T` for exclusive references, no Rust macros, no Python imports.
Declare effects explicitly on functions that use IO, mutation, division, allocation, panic, approximation, or observation.
Avoid semicolon-terminated statements except where Sounio syntax requires punctuation inside declarations.
name: sounio-ai-eval-prompts-v1
